headline: MODEL INDEX — the arcade now knows where free 3D models live
lede: #1140 shipped as a link index at /retrogames/models/libraries.json: five sources (Kenney, Quaternius, Poly Haven, Khronos samples, NVIDIA SimReady) with what each holds, its license scope, formats, and SimReady's physics record kept so robot-learning games can find real mass/friction/collision data later. The license gate is code, not vibes.

notes.text: src/utils/modelLibrary.js ranks every license ship(CC0) < credit(CC-BY) < review(NC/unknown) < never(SCEA/ARR), strictest component wins; every declared verdict must recompute from it.
Shortlist of 8 Khronos candidates with licenses verified per-asset from each model's metadata.json — the Duck is SCEA (viewer test only, never ships), Box is CC0 2 KB (ships today).
licenseGate seeded at review made strict-max a lie — CC0 could never lower it; everything computed review. Seed from the first token. Caught by the check's own recompute gate.

npm run modelindexcheck: 58 gates, two built-in mutants (silent relicense flips a verdict; dropping a library breaks the five-library gate). docs/MODELS.md links it from AGENTS, AI, GAME-SHELL, FORGE and the shelf README.
